description: This file defines an abstract class 'BrowserType' for managing browser launching, connection, and process handling within the Playwright project. It includes methods for launching browsers, handling user data directories, process management, and transport connections, with project-specific references such as registry, transport, and browser context.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: An abstract class representing a browser type, providing methods for launching, connecting, and managing browser processes within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Returns the executable path for the browser type based on registry lookup.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the browser type.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a browser instance with specified options, handling retries and startup errors.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Launches a persistent browser context with user data directory and options.

methods.name: _innerLaunchWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to launch the browser with retries on specific errors.

methods.name: _innerLaunch
methods.description: Handles the core logic of launching a browser process, establishing transport, and creating the browser object.

methods.name: _prepareToLaunch
methods.description: Prepares directories, arguments, and executable path for launching.

methods.name: _launchProcess
methods.description: Starts the browser process, manages process signals, and establishes transport connection.

methods.name: _createArtifactDirs
methods.description: Creates directories for downloads and traces if specified.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over Chrome DevTools Protocol (only supported by Chromium).

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Connects to a Selenium remote hub (only supported by Chromium).

methods.name: _validateLaunchOptions
methods.description: Validates and adjusts launch options such as headless mode and proxy settings.

methods.name: _createUserDataDirArgMisuseError
methods.description: Generates an error message for incorrect userDataDir argument usage based on SDK language.

methods.name: _rewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites protocol error logs for better readability.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, default implementation returns empty object.

methods.name: prepareUserDataDir
methods.description: Prepares the user data directory before launching.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported (returns true).

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Returns the executable name based on options or default.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Abstract method to get default launch arguments for the browser.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Abstract method to connect to the browser transport.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Abstract method to amend environment variables for the launch process.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Abstract method to rewrite startup logs.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Abstract method to attempt graceful closure of the browser.
